claim_boundary: Research/product architecture for tracking hardware provenance, error origin, calibration action, and readiness assessment. Not a claim that practical fault-tolerant quantum computing is solved.

modules.name: Qubit Provenance Registry
modules.purpose: Give every device, qubit, wafer, die, material stack, and calibration lineage a stable identity.
modules.boundary_note: Provenance does not prove quality; it makes quality traceable.

modules.name: Temporal Error Memory
modules.purpose: Record errors across time so drift, repetition, and context can be studied.
modules.boundary_note: An error label is a hypothesis unless directly supported by measurement or literature.

modules.name: Predictive Calibration Engine
modules.purpose: Use past drift and error patterns to suggest when calibration should be checked or adjusted.
modules.boundary_note: Predictive suggestions require human review and physical validation.

modules.name: Quantum Digital Twin Layer
modules.purpose: Maintain a simulated or modeled counterpart of a device/system for what-if exploration.
modules.boundary_note: A digital twin is a model, not the physical system.

modules.name: Manufacturing Intelligence Mesh
modules.purpose: Connect manufacturing variation to device behavior and qubit performance.
modules.boundary_note: Correlation is not causation; process recommendations must be evidence-ranked.

modules.name: Quantum Knowledge Graph
modules.purpose: Connect materials, devices, errors, calibrations, evidence anchors, outcomes, and claim boundaries.
modules.boundary_note: Graph edges must state confidence and source status.

modules.name: AI-Assisted Calibration Search
modules.purpose: Help search the calibration and mitigation space while preserving human review and audit trails.
modules.boundary_note: AI assistance is not autonomous science. Human review remains required.

modules.name: Federated Research Grid
modules.purpose: Enable shared learning across labs, devices, and platforms without forcing private raw data exposure.
modules.boundary_note: Federation requires consent, privacy controls, and explicit data-sharing policy.

modules.name: Human-Reviewed Design Explorer
modules.purpose: Support exploration of new device architectures, control methods, calibration plans, and error models with human review.
modules.boundary_note: Design exploration proposes hypotheses; it does not validate them without experiment.

modules.name: Living Quantum Ledger
modules.purpose: Provide the long-term memory layer for devices, calibrations, experiments, errors, evidence, and lessons.
outputs: release notes and claim posture updates
modules.boundary_note: The ledger is only as strong as its source discipline, validation, and review process.
